_comment: nanoda_bin (independent Rust Lean 4 kernel) config for the Comparator re-check. Re-type-checks the FULL exported PythExpandVerify environment and hard-errors if ANY declaration USES an axiom outside permitted_axioms (unpermitted_axiom_hard_error:false => an unpermitted axiom that is only DECLARED-but-unused is skipped, not fatal). export_file_path is patched by run_comparator.sh.
_pinned_footprint_note: Our OWN theorems use ONLY {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} — enforced per-decl by the L1 axiom_footprint gate. Lean.trustCompiler is added here ONLY because exporting the WHOLE environment includes Lean-core declarations that reference it; no PythExpandVerify claim depends on it (L1 proves this).
